evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: The aphoristic framing converts an unmet rehearsal into an existential deficit — urgency-as-worry delivered through a declarative that withholds the safety it names.
Settled, low-arousal cadence language normalizing the rehearsal schedule into routine — satisfaction in the regularity itself, not excitement about it.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityAsAbsence
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting an unexercised capability into an existential void — treating what hasn't been practiced as something that doesn't exist?
